there is a positive impact on financial performance of banks in the presence of CIS, and the effect is more significant in case of public banks.
(a) the computerization of accounting information systems has a great effect on the auditing profession, and (b) the computerization has a great effect of the auditor’s role in the auditing process.
the computerized information system is very useful for the banks and also it is very helpful to the auditors for the audit purpose.

how to use CIS to enhance audit quality.
the impact of CIS on audit in the banking sector.
a comparison of the audit of CIS in public banks and private banks.

the audit under CIS in Public Banks and private Banks in Mumbai City is a very important and essential aspect.
the application of CIS in the financial institutions is very important and necessary.
the audit of computerised information system is a very important and complex task.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
CIS has the ability to improve the quality of financial information and to improve the efficiency of financial reporting.

the audit of computerized systems is a complex process and requires a thorough understanding of the system and of the business processes that it supports.
